title: English Practice Quiz 0279
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: What is the meaning of 'available'?
options: ready or able to be used
questions.explanation: Available means ready for use or accessible.

questions.question: A professional way to ask for a file is:
options: Could you please share the file?
questions.explanation: Could you please is a polite and professional request.

questions.question: I have ___ friends in this city.
questions.explanation: A few is used with countable plural nouns.

questions.question: A person you can trust is ___.
Read: 'The shop closes at 9 p.m., but it opens at 10 a.m.' When does it open?
questions.explanation: The opening time given is 10 a.m.

questions.question: She said, 'Please sit down.'
options: She asked me to sit down.
questions.explanation: A request can be reported with asked + object + to-infinitive.

questions.question: A person who repairs water pipes is a ___.
questions.explanation: A plumber installs and repairs water pipes and fittings.

questions.question: Which word has the /ʃ/ sound as in 'ship'?
The windows ___ every week.
questions.explanation: Plural subject windows takes are + past participle.

questions.question: They ___ football every Sunday.
questions.explanation: Use the base verb with the plural subject they in the present simple.
